name: Ironcap Archers
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Ranged Infantry · special · 110 leadership · T2 · Mastery
pitch: A cheap filler ranged unit that lags behind meta in impact. Standard archers teach poor game habits (no micro, deceptive safety, skill-stunting for new players) and force teammates to compensate — if you want range, pick exotic units instead.
